answer: In this PoA design, each bonded identity escrows collateral, and correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k²), rather than independent linear fines. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlled sybil swarm, making large collusive clusters economically prohibitive. A summit of false votes cannot become a vine of cheap replicas: one exposed root sends a ripple through every linked escrow.
